name: cuadrilla-node-typescript
description: Stack pack for cuadrilla: Node.js LTS + TypeScript strict backend on Fastify, 4 layers enforced by dependency-cruiser, Zod at the edge, hand-written SQL with pg (or Kysely), jose JWT, pino, Vitest. Adds the backend-node agent, the stack standard, CI/Docker templates and a feature scaffolder.
